desc: Build a host-only encoder/parser and unit-test harness for the pinned T6041/M4-family SPTM NVMe service-6 contracts decoded in 051/052/054. Validate descriptor packing, per-op lengths, queue/TCB/page-list ownership constraints, overflow/alignment rejection, and expected status decoding against static blobs. It must have no target transport or live GENTER path.
